```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cdk_version:
        description: 'CDK version to publish (e.g., 7.6.5)'
        required: true
        type: string
      base_image_tag:
        description: 'Base image tag to use (e.g., source-declarative-manifest:7.6.5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  publish-base-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/airbytehq/airbyte/source-declarative-manifest
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=${{ inputs.cdk_version }}
            type=raw,value=latest

      - name: Build and push base image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: airbyte-integrations/bases/base-normalization/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          build-args: |
            CDK_VERSION=${{ inputs.cdk_version }}
```
